import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

MAXN = 510

def update(x, y, p):
    return (x + y) % p

def compute(x, p):
    return (x * (x - 1) // 2) % p

def main():
    data = input().split()
    n, m, p = map(int, data[:3])
    # Initialize combination array
    c = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
    for i in range(MAXN):
        c[i][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, MAXN):
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j - 1] + c[i - 1][j]) % p

    f = [0] * (MAXN)
    g = [0] * (MAXN)
    g[0] = 1

    for i in range(1, m + 1):
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            term1 = c[i - 1][j - 1] * f[j - 1] % p * g[i - j] % p * (i + 1) % p
            term2 = c[i - 1][j - 1] * g[j - 1] % p * f[i - j] % p * (i + 1) % p
            val1 = update(f[i], term1 + term2 + (c[i - 1][j - 1] * g[j - 1] % p * g[i - j] % p) * ((compute(j, p) + compute(i - j + 1, p)) % p), p)
            f[i] = val1
            g[i] = update(g[i], c[i - 1][j - 1] * g[j - 1] % p * g[i - j] % p * (i + 1), p)

    # Initialize DP arrays
    dp = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
    ways = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
    dp[0][0] = 0
    ways[0][0] = 1

    for i in range(n):
        dp2 = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
        ways2 = [[0] * (MAXN) for _ in range(MAXN)]
        for j in range(min(i, m) + 1):
            for k in range(min(j, m) + 1):
                if k == 0:
                    dp0 = dp[j][0]
                    ways0 = ways[j][0]
                else:
                    dp0 = 0
                    ways0 = 0
                # Update dp2 and ways2
                dp2[j][0] = update(dp2[j][0], dp[j][k], p)
                ways2[j][0] = update(ways2[j][0], ways[j][k], p)
                rem = m - (j - k)
                if rem >= 0:
                    ways2[j + 1][k + 1] = update(ways2[j + 1][k + 1], ways0 * c[rem][k + 1] % p * g[k + 1] % p, p)
                    dp2[j + 1][k + 1] = update(dp2[j + 1][k + 1], dp0 * c[rem][k + 1] % p * g[k + 1] % p + ways0 * c[rem][k + 1] % p * f[k + 1] % p, p)
        # Copy back
        for j in range(MAXN):
            for k in range(MAXN):
                dp[j][k] = dp2[j][k]
                ways[j][k] = ways2[j][k]

    answer = 0
    for i in range(m + 1):
        answer = update(answer, dp[m][i], p)
    print(answer)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
